tei:div.tei:p: g.yang 'gugs mdor bsdus bya bar spro na/ mda' dar dang*/ phye mar g.yang rdzas ci 'byor bshams la/ skyabs sems ni/ skyabs 'os rnams la gus pas skyabs mchi zhing*// 'gro sgrol slad du byang chub sems mchog bskyed// sems can bde ldan sdug bsngal rgyur bcas bral// bde las mi nyams btang snyoms ngang gnas shog / dngos gzhi ni/ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las snod bcud dag pa'i zhing*// yid 'phrog nor bu brtsegs pa'i gzhal med dbus// phul byung mchod pa'i sprin gyi lding khang du// dus gsum rgyal ba'i ye shes gcig bsdus dpal// rtsa ba'i bla ma o rgyan rdo rje 'chang*// rgyas pa'i las mdzad ratna thod phreng rtsal// rab 'byams nor lha rgya mtsho'i 'khor gyis bskor// dran pa tsam gyis 'dod dgu'i char 'beb bsam// gnas gsum 'bru gsum mtshan las 'od 'phros pas// dbyings nas ye shes spyan drangs gnyis med gyur// hūm̐ hrīḥ 'og min gnas dang 'gro 'dul sprul zhing nas// bla ma rtsa gsum nor lha rab 'byams tshogs// thugs dam rjes dgongs 'dir gshegs byin phob la// tshe dang longs spyod 'dod dgu'i dngos grub stsol// dam ye dbyer med rten la dgyes par bzhugs// sgo gsum gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal zhing*// dngos 'byor yid sprul kun bzang mchod sprin 'bul// che ba'i yon tan rjes dran glu yis bstod// thugs dam bskul lo dbyings nas thugs rjes gzigs// bdag cag snyigs ma'i dus mthar skyes rnams la// skyabs gnas re ltos khyed las ma mchis pas// thugs rjes gzigs la 'dod dgu'i dngos grub stsol/ /lha tshogs thugs las 'od zer mkha' khyab 'phros// rab 'byams phyogs bcu'i zhing khams ji snyed nas// 'khor 'das lam gyi phywa g.yang dpal 'byor kun// sprin ltar bsdus nas bdag la bstsal bar gyur// ces mos la/ spro na/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru ratna thod phreng rtsal sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐/

zhes ratna thod phreng rtsal dang*/ nor lha spyi bye brag gi sngags/ oṃ bai shrā ma ṇā ya swā hā/ oṃ dzambha la dza lend+ra ya swā hā/ oṃ bā su dhā ri ṇi swā hā/ zhes dang*/ tadya thā/ hi li ma ṇi bha dra/ hi li hi li ma ṇi bha dra/ ki li ma ṇi bha dra/ ki li ki li ma ṇi bha dra/ ku ru ma ṇi bha dra/ ku ru ku ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tu ru tu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ su ru ma ṇi bha dra/ su ru su ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tsu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tsu ru tsu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ oṃ e hye hi/ tiṣṭha tiṣṭha/ sarba artha me sā dha ni/ tadya thā/ su dha ni/ su ra sya/ su ma ti/ su pu ṣi/ hi li mi li swā hā/ zhes nor lha spyi'i gzungs kyang ci rigs brjod/ gang ltar yang mda' dar g.yab cing*/ kyai/ phun tshogs dge legs bye ba'i dpal yon can// dran pa tsam gyis 'dod dgu'i char 'beb pa'i// rab 'byams rtsa gsum nor lha gter bdag tshogs// deng 'dir gdung bas 'bod do brtse bas dgongs/ khyod ni nam mkha' mdzod la mnga' brnyes shing*// dbul ba'i gdung sel yid bzhin nor las lhag /sngon smon tha tshig btsan po rjes dgongs la// deng 'dir tshe bsod 'dod dgu'i gru char phob// bdag sogs 'gro ba ma rig rmongs pa'i mthus// ser sna 'phags min sgrib pa'i khur lcis non// 'phags rnams thugs dang 'gal ba'i nongs bgyis kun// mthol zhing bshags so byang zhing dag par mdzod// 'gro ba las kyi rgyu la khag 'che na/ khyod kyi thugs bskyed mthu nus ci ltar rung*// de slad phyi ma'i dus la mi ltos par// da lta nyid du 'dod 'bras mchis par mdzod// sangs rgyas byang sems bstan 'dzin dge ba'i bshes// lung rtogs dam chos bshad sgrub phrin las rgyun// lha klu gnod sbyin mi yi dpal 'byor stobs// ma lus bkra shis gnas 'dir g.yang du khug /gling bzhi nyi zla rtsi sman snod kyi bcud// rigs gzugs stobs 'byor shes rig bcud kyi dpal// phun tshogs sde bzhi'i dpal yon ji snyed pa// ma lus dbang du sdus la deng 'dir stsol// 'chi med tshe dang rgas med lang tsho'i dpal// 'jigs med spobs pa rgud med rnam dpyod blo// bcud chen zas dang brjid chen gos la sogs// srid zhi'i dpal yon ma lus deng 'dir stsol/

khyad par stong dang rten 'byung zung 'jug pa'i// 'od gsal sems kyi chos nyid sgrib bral gshis// mngon gyur 'dzad med spobs pa'i gter chen gyis// don gnyis dga' ston mchog tu rgyas par mdzod// rmad byung byang chub sems kyi rten 'brel gyis// bdag snang dbang 'dus gzhan snang zil gyis non// kun kyang theg pa mchog gis rgyud grol nas// rnam grol yon tan gter la dbang 'byor mdzod// bcud kyi spyod pas snod kyi dge mtshan spel// snod kyi dpal yon bcud kyi gsos sman grub// phan tshun rgyu rkyen rten 'brel gcig tu tshogs// rdzogs ldan gsar du 'char ba'i bkra shis shog / ces pa dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru ratna thod phreng rtsal sogs/ zhes bzlas mthar dngos grub len pa ni/ hūm̐/ bde mchog bde spyod nam mkha'i dkyil yangs nas// rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor sras bcas thugs dam can// 'chi med rtsa gsum nor lha rab 'byams kyis// sku gsung thugs dang mnyam sbyor dngos grub ni// phrin las yid bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i dpal// bum pa bzang dang dpag bsam nor bu'i tshul// da lta nyid du bstsal zhing brtan par mdzod// 'gyur med sku yi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// 'gag med gsung gi dngos grub= 'khrul med thugs kyi dngos grub= yon tan re skong dngos grub= phrin las 'gro 'dul dngos grub= 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub= 'dzad med nor gyi dngos grub= thun mong yid bzhin dngos grub= bla med mchog gi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru ratna thod phreng rtsal sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐/ kā ya wā ka tsitta siddhi hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ ye dharma dang su pra tiṣṭha sogs brjod pas rten la bstims rjes/ bag med nyams chag gyur kun bzod mdzod la/ dam tshig ye shes rang dang dbyer med thim// dge bas 'gro kun tshogs gnyis yongs rdzogs nas// rnam grol sku gnyis 'bras bu mngon byed shog

/'bad dang rtsol bas ma gos pa// yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam bzhin// sems can re ba skong mdzad pa// bsam pa 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog / ces sogs shis brjod ji ltar rigs pas mtha' brgyan par bya'o// zhes pa'ang nyer mkho'i yan lag tu 'gyur med padma bstan 'dzin gyis zhe chen rgyal tshab padma rnam rgyal rin po che/bris pa rten 'byung 'gag pa med pa'i rang rtsal myur du ston pa'i rgyur gyur cig// / ༈ dpe tshan 'di sngon chad gter mdzod dkyus su med cing*/ bal yul zhe dgon gyi par gsar 'dir gsar bzhag byas pas lung rgyun la zhib rtog dgos pa yin no//
